## About the Video

Host: Katie Harris
Camera: Matteo Alabiso
Part of the Easy Languages network (http://www.easy-languages.org/)

This episode features street interviews in Milan asking people why they live there. Topics covered include:
- Job opportunities in Milan
- Cultural and social life
- Public transportation (metro, bicycles, scooters)
- Differences between Milan and other Italian cities (Naples, Sardinia)
- Pros and cons of living in a big city
- The NoLo (North of Loreto) neighborhood
- Cost of living

Source: Easy Italian YouTube Channel - September 2020
